content: Kiara Sen discussed her policy renewal quote with insurance agent Sunita Agarwal. Kiara inquired about a 12% premium increase and pre-existing condition (asthma) coverage after her policy lapsed. Sunita explained the medical inflation, the waiting period reset, and offered a 5% annual payment discount along with an asthma waiver if a physician report is provided. Ultimately, Kiara decided not to proceed with the renewal due to the cost and waiting period, and Sunita agreed to process the cancellation.
